import rhinoscriptsyntax as rs

def import\_dwg(filepath):
 filename = rs.GetFileName(filepath)
 base_layer_name = rs.RemoveExtension(filename)
 parent_layer = rs.AddLayer(base_layer_name)
 rs.CurrentLayer(parent_layer)
 
 rs.Command("\_-Import " + filepath + " \_Enter", True)
 layer_names = rs.LayerNames()
 for layer_name in layer_names:
 if layer_name != base_layer_name:
 rs.ParentLayer(layer_name, parent_layer)

filepath = rs.OpenFileName("Open DWG file", "AutoCAD (\*.dwg)|\*.dwg||", "")
if filepath:
 import_dwg(filepath)
else:
 print("Import failed")
